title: Step 1 - Using Scikit-Learn to Replace Missing Values in Machine Learning

cues.en: Instructor: Okay, my friends, so now let's add a new tool to our data preprocessing toolkit, which is taking care of missing data.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，現在替資料前處理工具箱新增一個工具，也就是處理遺漏資料。

cues.en: So indeed, if we have a look again at our dataset, Data.csv, we notice that there is a missing salary here for this specific customer from Germany
cues.zh: 再看一次 Data.csv，可以發現這位德國客戶的薪資

cues.en: of 40 years old, and who purchased the product.
cues.zh: 沒有填寫；他 40 歲，而且購買了產品。

cues.en: So, generally you don't want to have any missing data in your data set, for the simple reason that it can cause some errors when training your machine learning model, and therefore you must handle them.
cues.zh: 一般而言，我們不希望資料集有遺漏值，因為訓練模型時可能出錯，所以必須處理。

cues.en: there are actually several ways to handle them, a first way is to just ignore the observation by deleting it.
cues.zh: 處理方法有幾種，第一種是直接刪除該筆觀測資料。

cues.en: That's one method, and this actually works if you have a large data set, and you know, if you have only 1% missing data, you know removing 1% of the observations won't change much
cues.zh: 如果資料集很大，而且只有 1% 遺漏資料，這種方法確實可行，因為刪除 1% 的觀測值，不太會改變

cues.en: the learning quality of your model, so 1% is fine, but sometimes you can have a lot of missing data, and therefore you must handle them the right way.
cues.zh: 模型的學習品質。1% 通常沒問題，但有時遺漏資料很多，就必須用適當方法處理。

cues.en: So that was the first way to ignore them, to remove them, and now a second way, and this is what we're adding right now in the toolkit, is to actually replace the missing data,
cues.zh: 第一種方式是忽略並刪除；第二種，也就是現在要加入工具箱的方法，是用

cues.en: you know, the missing value, by the average of all the values in the column, in which the data is missing.
cues.zh: 遺漏值所在欄位全部數值的平均數，來取代這個遺漏值。

cues.en: So here we have a missing salary, what we want to do, is to replace this missing salary by the average of all these salaries.
cues.zh: 這裡缺少薪資，我們就用所有這些薪資的平均數來填補。

cues.en: This is a classic way of handling missing data, and I'm going to teach it to you right away.
cues.zh: 這是處理遺漏值的常見方法，現在就來學。

cues.en: So here we go, taking care of missing data, let's create a new code cell, and let's replace that missing salary by the average of all the salaries here.
cues.zh: 建立新的程式儲存格，準備用這一欄的平均薪資，取代缺少的薪資。

cues.en: All right, so to do this, we're gonna use the libraries, and actually I'm about to introduce you to one of the best data science libraries, I'm talking about scikit-learn,
cues.zh: 這裡要使用函式庫，現在正式介紹最好的資料科學函式庫之一：scikit-learn。

cues.en: scikit-learn is an amazing data science libraries containing a lot of tools, including a lot of data preprocessing tools.
cues.zh: scikit-learn 是很棒的資料科學函式庫，提供大量工具，其中包括許多資料前處理工具。

cues.en: You will see that we will actually use scikit-learn a lot in this course.
cues.zh: 這門課會經常使用 scikit-learn。

cues.en: More than half of the machine learning models we will build in this course will be built with scikit-learn.
cues.zh: 超過一半的模型，都會用 scikit-learn 建立。

cues.en: So if you don't know scikit-learn yet, I'm telling you, you're going to absolutely love it.
cues.zh: 如果你還不認識它，我相信你一定會喜歡。

cues.en: And so for the first time here, we're gonna use scikit-learn to handle missing data, and to do this the class that we're gonna use from Psych Learn, is called SimpleImputer.
cues.zh: 這裡第一次使用 scikit-learn 來處理遺漏資料，要用的類別叫做 SimpleImputer。

cues.en: We're actually going to first import that SimpleImputer class, then we will create an instance, you know, an object of the SimpleImputer class.
cues.zh: 先匯入 SimpleImputer 類別，再建立它的實例，也就是物件。

cues.en: This object will allow us to exactly replace this missing salary here, by the average of the salaries, and then we will have an updated data set,
cues.zh: 這個物件可以將缺少的薪資，替換成平均薪資，讓資料集更新。

cues.en: you know, an updated actually matrix of features, because we will apply this imputer on the matrix of features only, so we'll have a new matrix of features with no missing data,
cues.zh: 更確切地說，是更新特徵矩陣，因為 imputer 只會套用到特徵矩陣，得到沒有遺漏值的新矩陣，

cues.en: because the missing salary will have been replaced by the average salary.
cues.zh: 因為原本缺少的薪資，已經被平均薪資取代。

cues.en: All right, let's do this.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: Perfect, so first, since this class belongs to scikit-learn, well we're gonna start here by going from scikit-learn, which has the name sklearn.
cues.zh: 首先，這個類別屬於 scikit-learn，所以要從名稱為 sklearn 的函式庫匯入。

cues.en: So sklearn, then remember, in order to access a module, we have to add a dot, because actually this SimpleImputer class which we want to import belongs
cues.zh: 寫 sklearn，再加句點來存取模組，因為要匯入的 SimpleImputer 類別，屬於

cues.en: to a certain module of scikit-learn called impute, this one, impute, and from this impute module, well we are going to import, there we go,
cues.zh: scikit-learn 的 impute 模組；從這個 impute 模組，匯入

cues.en: the SimpleImputer class, see?
cues.zh: SimpleImputer 類別。

cues.en: Google Colab really assists you well, SimpleImputer class, perfect.
cues.zh: Google Colab 的自動提示非常方便，就是 SimpleImputer。

cues.en: Then next step, as I said, the next step is to create an instance of this class, which you can exactly see as the tool itself.
cues.zh: 接著如前所述，要建立這個類別的實例，可以把它視為工具本身。

cues.en: You know, the tool that you'll use to replace that missing salary by the average of salaries.
cues.zh: 也就是用平均薪資替換遺漏薪資的工具。

cues.en: So since we're about to create a new object, well, we have to introduce here, a new variable, and we're gonna call this variable imputer, okay?
cues.zh: 既然要建立新物件，就引入一個新變數，叫做 imputer。

cues.en: Imputer, which will exactly this object of the SimpleImputer class.
cues.zh: imputer 就是 SimpleImputer 類別的物件。

cues.en: And therefore, since it'll be the object of the SimpleImputer class, well, we have naturally to call this class, SimpleImputer.
cues.zh: 因此，要建立這個物件，自然就要呼叫 SimpleImputer 類別。

cues.en: So I'm going to copy this and paste that here.
cues.zh: 我先複製，再貼到這裡。

cues.en: That's how you create an object to the class, you simply call the class, then you add some parenthesis, and there you go, now you're gonna enter the right arguments in order to replace indeed
cues.zh: 建立類別物件的方法，就是呼叫類別，再加上括號。接著傳入適當引數，才能用

cues.en: this missing salary, by the average of salaries, because note that there are actually many replacements that you could do, you could, instead of replacing it by the average salary,
cues.zh: 平均薪資填補缺少的薪資。不過，可以填補的值其實有很多種，不一定非得用平均薪資，

cues.en: you could replace it by the median salary, you know, there is difference between the average and the median.
cues.zh: 也可以使用薪資中位數；平均數與中位數並不相同。

cues.en: You could also replace a missing value by the most frequent value, right?
cues.zh: 還可以用最常出現的值填補遺漏值。

cues.en: That would be, for example, relevant for categories, okay?
cues.zh: 例如，這可能適合用在類別資料。

cues.en: So you have many options, but the most classic one and the one option that I recommend is the average salary, the mean salary, okay?
cues.zh: 選擇很多，但最常見、也是我在這裡建議的方式，是平均數，也就是平均薪資。

cues.en: And so, that's exactly what we have to enter here.
cues.zh: 所以這就是接下來要輸入的設定。

cues.en: First, we have to specify which missing values we have to replace.
cues.zh: 首先，要指定哪一種遺漏值需要替換。

cues.en: And so that's why we have to enter here first argument called missing_values, which has to be equal to np, you know, the NumPy library, .nan,
cues.zh: 第一個引數叫 missing_values，設成 np，也就是 NumPy 函式庫，後面接 .nan。

cues.en: and that's just to say that we want to replace all the missing value in the data set, like this one, this is like an empty value, this is what this means, an empty value,
cues.zh: 這表示要替換資料集裡所有這類遺漏值，像這個空值就是它代表的意思。

cues.en: and then the second argument we have to input here is exactly the one saying that indeed the missing_values here, the empty values of the data set will be replaced by the mean.
cues.zh: 第二個引數，則指定這些 missing_values，也就是資料集中的空值，要用平均數取代。

cues.en: And to do this, we have to add the next argument here, which is strategy, and this argument will be equal to, in quote, mean, okay?
cues.zh: 要這麼做，就加入 strategy 引數，並設為引號中的 mean。

cues.en: And that's just to say that we want indeed to replace all the missing values in the matrix of features by the mean of the feature itself.
cues.zh: 這表示特徵矩陣中的遺漏值，都以該特徵本身的平均數填補。
